_comment: UC1 P5-a trust-panel BACKTEST config (design spec §4). Temporal holdout boundaries + duration-class thresholds live here so backtest.js has nothing scoring-related hardcoded. Year 1 = fit window, Year 2 = predicted/compared window. Both bounds are [start, end) on incident_date (ISO local, e.g. '2024-05-27T00:00:00').

durationClasses._comment: Coarse short/medium/long bucketing of lane_closure_duration_hours. short: <= shortMaxHours. medium: <= mediumMaxHours. long: above.
